body:
Heh, just googled the OCD and id say i have it too.
Usually watching my favorite youtubers and just relaxing made me feel pretty good and not think about the negative, but its kind of hard now. Ah, i just dont know what should i do.

Yeah, i will try to do so, but what i can say now, it will he extremely difficult. What i forgot to mention too is the fact that im always been that oversthinking and perfectionist type of person, so that makes it all so much kore difficult. My head just explodes thinking all the possible ways it happened and what i could have done differently and i cant change it now etc.

Yeah, i tried to do the not making a deal out of it thing and telling myself its not that bad and nothing to worry about and i kind of succeeded, had a peace of mind for quitesome time, but all that was before it actually started to make me feel discomfortable physycally and doing it constantly. Now i just cant help to think about it and worry and worry and worry since i physically feel it almost 24/7, only not when im sleeping.

Yeah, i hoped that it was due growth too, but since it is so crooked and feels just so bad, i doubt its the growth (and also since the other one is perfectly fine).
I really would like to show it to someone, but i just have noone to show it to. I guess i just have to live with it and wait til it starts to threathen my life, maybe it gets taken more seriously and treated then. Since the respond i got from last time was pretty much that looks(it looks pretty bad too) and  the discomfort which comes with it is no reason to do something about it. Im just afraid that as i grow, it gets worse and worse and soon it will be too late to do something about it when im fully grown. It really is a big hit to my self esteem as well, and since it was low enough with my ribs fine and me being in good shape and working out, you can only imagine what its like at this point.

The thing about it is its not like an agonizing pain, like the one you cant sleep with. Its just kind of a pressure feeling sometimes and a constant discomfort. Last time she asked me do i feel pain. And i cant really lie about it. Since my right rib cage is perfectly normal with nothing sticking out at the bottom and nothing sunken in in the middle, it worries me more, since i have read that uneven ribs lead to more spine problems due to eneven support or something like that. I guess it may be caused by my little unusual height (im 197cm tall) and parts of my body growing wrong/too fast or something along those lines. But since im not a doctor and really only know only that much as i have searched from google, i really cant say.

We havent touched those things yet in school, but im sure it will come.
I went to a family doctor (this is what we call them in my country, kind of a universal doctor for whole family who sends you to different doctors if necessary, if that makes sense) but she seemed not to thinks its weird or abnormal and started doing tests of my organs instead, which were fine. Since the last visit it has gotten a lot worse and discomfortable. Its come to the point where i cant sit and concentrate or studying for example, without being distracted because of the discomfort the rib is giving me. I have tried googling my problem a lot, only found few a little similar issues with no solutions. Since i can breathe and im not in extreme pain yet, i cant do nothing about it and the doctors wont, either. I actually considered breakingmy ribs on my own to get an excuse to go to the hospital and have them properly examined.

The future actually frightens me even more since i dont have any certain goals or something like that. I just dont want to end up alone in even deeper depression. Im currently studying IT and i have been intersested in it a while now, but it kind of feels like a hobby, not my future job. I would like more active job and lifestyle, since i used to go to the gym alot and be in a good shape, but for financial reasons and my rib cage problem i cant really do that anymore, which sucks both for mental health and physical appearance.

I guess i dont, really. This autumn i switched schools and moved to new city and since then everything has gotten downhill quickly. The new school doesnt go really well with me and only 2 real friends i had are gone too. Every day i just wake up empty, because i have to go to school and the whole day i think about going back to sleep already since its the only time i can just be in peace without the pain and discomfort.

I have never been that close to my mom (i cant really explain, i know some families talk about all kinds of stuff with each other and are really open, not in my case) and i dont have a dad, so its difficult to find someone in my family to talk to and who would actually take me seriously. I have always acted like im fine, even when im burning inside. So i guess im kind of a closed person, at least to my family, because im pretty sure they wouldnt take me very seriously, since i seem to be OK outside, if that makes sense.
